title: Data Acquisition and Feature Building
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of update_data, make_dataset, and Google Trends, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in stock-price-trend-predictor.
learning_objectives: Explain update_data, make_dataset, and Google Trends in plain language and connect it to src/data/update_data.py; src/data/make_dataset.py.
Trace one input through the data acquisition and feature building stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the data acquisition and feature building stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for update_data, make_dataset, and Google Trends.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
